title: USCG Short; Rescue of 4 Canadians from capsized catamaran.
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City aircrew rescued four people from an overturned 60-foot catamaran, about 140 miles southeast of Wilmington, North Carolina, on Saturday, Oct. 21, 2023.  The Coast Guard 5th District Command Center in Portsmouth, Va. received a signal from an Emergency Position Indicating Radio Beacon (EPIRB) at 12:18 p.m. from the Moon Dragon, a yacht that charters between the Mid-Atlantic and the Virgin Islands.  (U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Elizabeth City)
